params.name: id
params.description: Full 16-character hexadecimal Amiibo identifier (combination of head and tail).

params.name: head
params.description: First 8 hexadecimal characters of the Amiibo ID representing game series, character, variant, and type.

params.name: tail
params.description: Last 8 hexadecimal characters of the Amiibo ID representing the amiibo model and series.

params.name: name
params.description: Filter by Amiibo name (case-insensitive substring match).

params.name: character
params.description: Filter by character name or hexadecimal character ID (prefix with 0x for hex).

params.name: gameseries
params.description: Filter by game series name or hexadecimal game series ID (prefix with 0x for hex).

params.name: amiiboSeries
params.description: Filter by Amiibo series name or hexadecimal amiibo series ID (prefix with 0x for hex).

params.name: type
params.description: Filter by Amiibo type name (e.g., Figure, Card, Yarn) or hexadecimal type ID (prefix with 0x for hex).

params.name: variant
params.description: Filter by hexadecimal variant ID.

params.name: amiibo_model
params.description: Filter by hexadecimal Amiibo model ID.

params.name: switch_titleid
params.description: Filter by Nintendo Switch game title ID.

params.name: wiiu_titleid
params.description: Filter by Wii U game title ID.

params.name: 3ds_titleid
params.description: Filter by Nintendo 3DS game title ID.

params.name: showgames
params.description: When present, includes compatible game data for each Amiibo (games for 3DS, Wii U, and Switch with title IDs).

params.name: showusage
params.description: When present, includes compatible game data along with usage information describing how the Amiibo is used in each game.

params.name: sort
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to sort by. Valid values: id, head, tail, name, gameseries, gameseries_id, gameseries_name, character, character_id, character_name, variant, variant_id, type, type_id, type_name, amiibo_model, amiibo_model_id, series, series_id, series_name, release_na, release_jp, release_eu, release_au.

items.docs: Returns all Amiibo figures or filters by provided query parameters. Supports optional modifiers to include compatible game data and usage information. Results can be sorted by various fields.
